user.title: Connect to your pergola
user.description:
Select the pergola detected nearby, then enter its client ID and PIN.

{warning}

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the pergola. Check that it is powered on, in range, and not currently connected to another app.

init.title: Weather entity
init.description: Used by both "Wind protection" and "Winter sun mode" to know when it's raining or windy. Most Home Assistant installs already have one for free (e.g. a Met.no entity auto-added during onboarding) - check Developer Tools → States for anything starting with "weather." if you're not sure.
